name: Shri Jagannath Temple, Puri
path: Shri Jagannath Temple, Puri, Puri, India
summary: One of the four sacred Char Dham sanctuaries, home to Lord Jagannath, Balabhadra, and Subhadra.
points: Built in the 12th century CE (c. 1161 CE) by King Anantavarman Chodaganga Deva of the Eastern Ganga dynasty
Venue of the world-famous annual Ratha Yatra (Chariot Festival) drawing millions of pilgrims
Features the world's largest kitchen running on traditional earthen pots where food is blessed as Mahaprasad

name: Sun Temple, Konark (Black Pagoda)
path: Sun Temple, Konark (Black Pagoda), Puri, India
summary: 13th-century stone chariot architectural marvel carved with 24 sun wheels and seven horses.
points: Built in 1250 CE by King Narasimhadeva I of the Eastern Ganga dynasty; UNESCO World Heritage Site
Designed in the form of a colossal chariot of Surya (Sun God) with 24 intricately carved stone wheels acting as sundials
Celebrated for its monumental erotic Mithuna sculptures and dynamic Natya Mandapa dancers
